text:
Nora Chen: Hi all, first day! Quick security question: my company laptop shipped with FileVault off and I keep getting Duo 'connection timeout'. Also saw a phishing sim notice in my email. Should I start the security modules now or wait for an invite? Can I use my personal Android phone for Duo or do we require company devices?

Priya Kapoor: Welcome Nora! :wave: Start the modules when they show up in Learning, they often auto-assign within 24h. Phishing sims are cohort-based; you'll get the test the week after assignment. Personal Androids are allowed for Duo but we require a lockscreen + encryption. If you prefer not to register a personal device, let us know and we can set temporary OTP tokens.

IT Support: Nora, please run `sudo fdesetup status` and paste output. For Duo timeouts try reinstalling the app and ensure VPN is off during enrollment. If needed, open ticket with screenshot of error and we'll remote in.

Nora Chen: fdesetup says "FileVault is Off". Duo reinstall didn't help, error: "connection timeout (101)".

Marcus Hale: Hey Nora, I can remote for 15 mins. Likely DNS or proxy issue causing Duo timeout. Also we should enable FileVault; if you want I can trigger via Jamf enrollment.

Nora Chen: Jamf pushed and FileVault now showing as "Enabling". Marcus let's do the remote session at 2pm PT.

training-bot: Security training assigned: "New Hire Security Basics" -> Nora Chen. Due: 2025-06-12. Link: https://training.redwood-internal/learn/nh-security-basics

Priya Kapoor: FYI if you fail a phishing sim you'll get immediate feedback and a 10-min micro-training. No punitive action for first-time mistakes.

Nora Chen: Thanks everyone. Appreciate the fast help :smile:
